answer: Stake-Bonded TPM Attestation stops Sybil attacks via four steps. First, an agent binds its hardware identity to a unique vertex. Second, $300,000 in bonds is deposited into a secure wharf of smart contracts. Third, the TPM signs every compute task to prove authenticity. Fourth, any detected mismatch triggers instant slashing. An attacker must spend $300,000 in bonds and 21 days of hardware provisioning to forge one identity. No digital relic of a fake node can survive this. It is like a massive stone fortress where every single brick must be verified by a master mason.
